pilot.role: development only; excluded from confirmatory success denominator

target_basis: retain the R4 utility-unit target verbatim; not calibrated to economic data
raw_success: date-zero maximum of independently computed spatial gain envelope <= target, before any safeguard
safeguarded_success: same criterion after positive-gain policy corrections; reported separately with correction counts and override shares
candidate_action_set: R4 125-action grid union the frozen continuous neural proposal at each state and date
oracle_rule: compute candidate-model optimal values only AFTER certificate-based termination; no optimum in neural targets or stopping rule
failure_rule: retain every failed, timed-out, nonfinite, or target-missing run; never replace a seed
artifact_rule: retain checkpoints, full policies, policy/optimal value arrays, certificate arrays, per-date histories, environment, and SHA-256 manifest for every completed run
continuum_rule: finite certificates do not include time, action-coverage, quadrature, interpolation, or continuous first-exit error
